This chain of interactions implies that 15-Dehydroxythyrsenol A may influence the activity of 4,4-Dimethylcholesterol, which ultimately affects CCF-STTG1. The mechanism is likely mediated through the regulation of glycoprotein receptor function, which could modulate cellular signaling pathways involving CCF-STTG1. The evidence supports a dependency on cholesterol metabolism as a potential pathway, though the exact molecular interactions remain to be elucidated.
